_meta.description: Illustrative embodied carbon benchmarks for common IT devices (manufacturing + transport, excluding use phase). Midpoints and ranges compiled from publicly available manufacturer PCF sheets (Apple, Dell, HP, Lenovo). ALWAYS prefer the actual PCF of the specific model when available; flag these values as estimates.
_meta.usage_note: annualized_kgco2e = embodied_midpoint / typical_lifetime_years; extending lifetime is the main lever on this figure

laptop_business.notes: 13-15 inch business class; embodied is typically 70-85% of lifecycle footprint in EU grid conditions

monitor_24_27.notes: panel manufacturing dominates; larger/higher-res panels at the top of the range

smartphone.notes: embodied is typically 80%+ of lifecycle footprint

server_1u_2u.notes: strongly configuration-dependent (RAM/SSD count dominates); use vendor PCF whenever possible
